verdict.rationale: Feitian documents HOTP functionality (HID keyboard auto-type) and dedicated OTP management tools (OTP Tool, FEITIAN Authenticator for Android, SK Manager covering FIDO/PIV/OTP), confirming legacy OTP support alongside FIDO. Missing for 10: no independent/hands-on verification of OTP slot capacity or interoperability with third-party OTP-consuming services, and no detail on TOTP (time-based) vs HOTP-only support.
